optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.fused: true for full, false for other configurations

loss: pixel L1 + 0.1 * mean absolute real/imag FFT error
data_order: Per-epoch permutation seed 42+epoch; per-sample crop/augmentation seed [42,epoch,slot]
evaluation: Final endpoint only; all 1000 native test images; pad to multiple of four and crop before metrics; no test-time augmentation
